en: Now, when going for a code-based solution,
no matter if you're building a workflow or
an agent, there are more decisions that need
to be made.
And that is the question,
how much you want to build on your own from
scratch,
or if you're willing to also use third-party
libraries or SDKs or entire frameworks that
can simplify the process of building an
agent. And that's also something we'll
explore in the code-based sections of this
course. There are many libraries and
packages you can use depending on which
programming language you choose to use that
can make your life easier. But of course,
it's always a trade-off. If you're using a
third-party library or package, you're again
losing some of that control. Often it's
worth it, of course, but it is something to
be aware of and consider.
